templates.why_chosen: Two dashed-outline containers (Load Balancer, LLM Replicas) stand in for panel frames, each internally nested three levels deep, connected by two labelled cross-panel arrows (Requests, Migration) that state exactly what crosses the boundary.
templates.what_to_learn: Use a dashed rounded outline as a lightweight panel boundary instead of a hard frame, and always label the arrows that cross between panels with the noun they carry (Requests, Migration) rather than leaving the connective implicit.

templates.why_chosen: High-confidence nested-stack exemplar reaching real depth inside one of two dashed panels: LLM Replicas nests a stacked GPU icon nesting Cross-adapter Batching, nesting a Base Model box, nesting two Adapter boxes, four levels deep.
templates.what_to_learn: When one side of a two-panel figure is actually a deep hierarchy, let it nest, GPU pool over batching over base model over per-request adapters, while the other panel stays shallow; use one accent colour only for the cross-cutting controller that ties both panels together.
